game.trivia.title: Quiz Night
game.trivia.howto.1: Read the question on the TV.
game.trivia.howto.2: Tap the matching shape on your phone. First tap counts!
game.trivia.howto.3: Be right, then be fast: quicker answers score more.
game.trivia.howto.4: Build a streak for bonus points. The final question counts double!
game.trivia.rules.answer.title: Answer
game.trivia.rules.answer.body: One answer per question; your first tap is final.
game.trivia.rules.points.title: Points
game.trivia.rules.points.body: Correct: 500 to 1000 points depending on speed (true/false: 250 to 500). Wrong: 0. Nobody ever goes below zero.
game.trivia.rules.streaks.title: Streaks
game.trivia.rules.streaks.body: Each correct answer in a row adds +100 (up to +300). A wrong answer or no answer resets it.
game.trivia.rules.final.title: Final question
game.trivia.rules.final.body: Double points. The leader can still be caught.
game.trivia.rules.ties.title: Ties
game.trivia.rules.ties.body: Same points? More correct answers wins; then faster total time.
game.trivia.coach.read: Read the question on the TV. The answers are coming…
game.trivia.coach.answer: Tap the shape of your answer. First tap is final!
game.trivia.coach.reveal: Who got it? Watch everyone jump on their answer.
game.trivia.coach.finalIntro: Last question, double points. Anything can happen.
game.trivia.pause.voidConfirm: Void this question? Its points are removed for everyone.
game.trivia.pause.endConfirm: End the quiz now and go to the podium?
game.trivia.pad.waiting: You’re in! You play from the next question.
game.trivia.final.title: Final question: double points!
game.trivia.leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
game.trivia.hold.title: Waiting for players…
game.trivia.hold.body: The quiz picks up as soon as someone is back.
game.trivia.results.title: The podium
game.trivia.error.answerInvalid: That answer isn’t on the board.
